Name: Nyapu Ivaras Portraits
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by @Nyapu and @Aelinore-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPCs included in the "Custom NPC Ivaras" mod by @Starfyzz!

^^These were a little rushed-- apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to @Nyapu and @Aelinore for the assets! Credits to @Starfyzz for the NPC mod!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip the download file "IvarasNPC" and then drag the "Custom NPC Ivaras 1.1.1" folder into your already existing folder for the main mod. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]OR you can find the "image" folder in the main mod's "assets" folder yourself and drag the replacers into it. Personally, I tend to do this just to ensure everything goes neatly where it is supposed to :P[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=5][u][b]UPDATE!![/b][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Huge thank you to @DolphinIsNotaFish for making a Content Patcher version of this mod. [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]It is the [CP] folder-- download it, unzip it, then drag the [CP] folder to your mods folder like you would any other mod! That's it :)[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]You need the "Custom NPC Ivaras" mod for these to work. [/color]

Downloads.Description: Content patcher version-- simply drag the unzipped folder into your mods folder!
